Module awtzero
Package awtzero.prefab

Class InbuiltShaders

java.lang.Object
awtzero.prefab.InbuiltShaders
public class InbuiltShaders extends Object
A utility class providing a collection of pre-defined static "shaders" for use with the parallel image processing functions.

This class is non-instantiable and provides:

  • Point Shaders: Consumer<PixelColor> for applyPixelShader.
  • Kernel Shaders: KernelShader for applyKernelShader.

  • Field Details

    • INVERT

      public static final Consumer<PixelColor> INVERT
      A point shader that inverts the image's colors (like a photo negative). Alpha is preserved.

    • GRAYSCALE

      public static final Consumer<PixelColor> GRAYSCALE
      A point shader that converts the image to grayscale using NTSC/PAL luminosity coefficients.

    • SEPIA

      public static final Consumer<PixelColor> SEPIA
      A point shader that applies a sepia tone, giving the image an antique, brownish look.

    • SHARPEN

      public static final KernelShader SHARPEN
      A kernel shader that applies a 3x3 sharpen filter. This enhances edges by increasing the contrast between adjacent pixels. Kernel: 0 -1 0 -1 5 -1 0 -1 0

    • SOBEL_EDGE_DETECT

      public static final KernelShader SOBEL_EDGE_DETECT
      A kernel shader for Sobel edge detection. This highlights pixels that form strong horizontal or vertical edges, resulting in a black-and-white edge map.

    • EMBOSS

      public static final KernelShader EMBOSS
      A kernel shader that creates a 3D "embossed" or "stamped" effect. Works best on grayscale images. Kernel: -2 -1 0 -1 1 1 0 1 2

  • Method Details

    • contrast

      public static Consumer<PixelColor> contrast(float factor)
      Returns a point shader that adjusts the image's contrast.
      Parameters:
      factor - A contrast factor. Values > 1.0 increase contrast. Values invalid input: '<' 1.0 decrease contrast. 1.0 = no change.
      Returns:
      A Consumer shader.

    • threshold

      public static Consumer<PixelColor> threshold(int level)
      Returns a point shader that applies a binary threshold. Pixels lighter than the threshold become white, and pixels darker become black.
      Parameters:
      level - The threshold level (0-255).
      Returns:
      A Consumer shader.

    • boxBlur

      public static KernelShader boxBlur(int radius)
      Returns a kernel shader that performs a box blur. It averages the color of all pixels in a square kernel of a given radius.
      Parameters:
      radius - The radius of the blur. 1 = 3x3 kernel, 2 = 5x5, etc.
      Returns:
      A KernelShader that can be passed to applyKernelShader.
